▲ RIVM: 3 NL CONTACTS FROM KLM FLIGHT TESTED — 2 NEGATIVE, 1 RESULT PENDING AS OF 09 MAY
▲ BRITISH CASE 3 (MARTIN ANSTEE) REDIRECTED TO NETHERLANDS — CONDITION IMPROVED EN ROUTE TO TENERIFE

sites.name: M/V HONDIUS
sites.desc: Dutch-flagged polar vessel en route to Granadilla port, Tenerife; ETA early hours Sunday 10 May, anchoring offshore — passengers transferred by tender boat to isolated cordoned quayside. All 147 aboard (87 passengers, 60 crew, 24 nationalities) asymptomatic as of 09 May per Oceanwide. One dead body still aboard; WHO in contact with operators on safe storage and transport. Disembarkation window closes Tuesday due to deteriorating coastal weather.

sites.name: USHUAIA / ARGENTINA ROUTE
sites.desc: Confirmed source investigation zone. Dutch index couple (Cases 1 & 2) conducted 4-month birdwatching road trip (27 Nov 2025–01 Apr 2026) across Chile, Uruguay, and Argentina; investigators suspect exposure at a Ushuaia landfill visited during a bird-watching excursion near Andes-virus-carrying rat habitat. Malbrán Institute actively capturing and testing rodents along the couple's route. Argentina reports 101 national hantavirus infections since Jun 2025, roughly double prior year; no Ushuaia cases in recent decades.

sites.name: SAINT HELENA
sites.desc: 32 passengers disembarked 24 Apr (corrected from 30; includes Dutch index male body and Dutch widow who later died). Index case body removed here. Swiss confirmed case also disembarked here. SA NICD contact-tracing 82 passengers + 6 crew from 25 Apr Airlink St Helena–Johannesburg flight ongoing. Of 7 UK nationals from St Helena disembarkation: 2 self-isolating in UK, others traced by UKHSA.

sites.name: JOHANNESBURG
sites.desc: Case 2 (Dutch widow, PCR+) died on arrival 26 Apr — only death currently PCR-confirmed as Andes virus. Case 3 (British guide Martin Anstee, 56, PCR+) initially treated at Johannesburg ICU, condition improved and subsequently redirected to Netherlands. NICD contact-traced 65+ contacts from 25 Apr Airlink St Helena–Johannesburg flight (82 pax + 6 crew). Asymptomatic South African woman (briefly in Barcelona) confirmed located and monitored in South Africa.

sites.name: AMSTERDAM / NIJMEGEN
sites.desc: British Case 3 (Anstee, 56) redirected to Netherlands after condition improved en route to Tenerife; Dutch crew member (41, confirmed) at Radboud UMC Nijmegen. Netherlands lab PCR-confirmed postmortem that German woman died of Andes virus (cause still officially under investigation per WHO). KLM flight attendant tested NEGATIVE 08 May. RIVM: 3 people with symptoms tested after KL592 airplane contact — 2 NEGATIVE, 1 result pending. GGD tracing KL592 passengers. Four medical staff (1 Italian, 3 Dutch) remain aboard Hondius.

sites.name: LONDON
sites.desc: UKHSA confirmed 2 British nationals PCR+ (one transferred to Netherlands, one originally treated South Africa) and flagged a 3rd suspected case on Tristan da Cunha. UK arranging repatriation flight for 19 passengers and 4 crew from Tenerife; FCDO/UKHSA RDT pre-positioned. Asymptomatic returning Britons to isolate up to 45 days per UKHSA guidance.

sites.name: PARIS
sites.desc: Eight French nationals identified as close contacts of confirmed case on 25 Apr Airlink St Helena–Johannesburg flight. One reporting mild symptoms, isolated pending PCR results. French health ministry coordinating diagnostics and quarantine measures.

sites.name: ZURICH
sites.desc: PCR-confirmed male passenger disembarked St Helena; self-presented to doctor after symptom onset, confirmed Andes virus at University Hospital Zurich. Wife (also on trip) asymptomatic and isolating. Swiss authorities conducting additional contact tracing.

sites.name: BERLIN
sites.desc: German woman died on board 02 May (fever/pneumonia onset 28 Apr). Netherlands laboratory postmortem PCR returned Andes virus positive; however, WHO and Wikipedia note the cause of death is still officially under investigation alongside the Dutch male (Apr 11). Asymptomatic 65-year-old German contact evacuated 06 May to Netherlands has returned to Germany. RKI contact tracing active.

sites.name: ALICANTE
sites.desc: 32-year-old woman hospitalized in negative-pressure isolation with respiratory symptoms consistent with hantavirus; was seated two rows behind Dutch deceased on 25 Apr St Helena–Johannesburg flight. Health Secretary Padilla noted this is 'a pretty unlikely case' given the distance. PCR results pending. Valencia Regional Health coordinating.

sites.name: TENERIFE
sites.desc: Hondius to anchor offshore Granadilla cargo port early Sunday 10 May — will NOT dock pier-side per Canary Islands Port Authority. Passengers transfer by tender boat to isolated quayside, then bus to airport. 14 Spanish passengers to Madrid's Gómez Ulla Military Hospital (single rooms, Ebola-level biosecurity, 60–80 extra staff hired, PCR on arrival + Day 7, twice-daily temp checks). Disembarkation window closes Tuesday; weather worsens from Monday. WHO/CDC/UKHSA/ECDC/RIVM teams pre-positioned.

sites.name: MADRID
sites.desc: Gómez Ulla Military Hospital fully activated to receive 14 Spanish Hondius passengers under quarantine protocol. Biosecurity measures equivalent to Ebola/COVID-19 protocols; 60–80 additional staff recruited. High-Level Isolation Unit (UAAN, 22nd floor) on standby for any passenger developing symptoms. Spain's Ministry of Health also preparing legal powers under Organic Law 3/1986 for mandatory quarantine if needed.

sites.name: BARCELONA
sites.desc: South African woman (asymptomatic flight contact of Dutch deceased) spent approximately one week in Barcelona before returning to South Africa. Located and confirmed asymptomatic by Spain's Health Minister García. Spanish and South African authorities monitoring; no local transmission identified.

sites.name: TRISTAN DA CUNHA
sites.desc: UKHSA confirmed suspected hantavirus case (08 May): British passenger who disembarked Hondius during 13–15 Apr stop; developed symptoms and sought medical advice. Spouse isolating. 6 additional guests joined Hondius at Tristan da Cunha per Oceanwide, increasing total contact tracing scope. Patient currently on island; UKHSA assessing remotely.

sites.name: SINGAPORE
sites.desc: Two male residents (aged 67 and 65) isolated in government facility; both disembarked Hondius at St Helena and were on 25 Apr Airlink St Helena–Johannesburg flight with confirmed case. One has mild rhinorrhea, second asymptomatic. PCR results pending. CDA notified 04–05 May; public risk in Singapore assessed as low.

sites.name: ONTARIO
sites.desc: Two Ontario residents self-isolating — Hondius passengers who returned home. Four Canadians total remain aboard vessel awaiting Tenerife evacuation. PHAC coordinating monitoring per 07 May government statement.

sites.name: QUEBEC
sites.desc: One Quebec resident self-isolating — not a Hondius passenger but shared homebound flight with two Canadian Hondius disembarkees. Asymptomatic; PHAC monitoring active.

sites.name: ARIZONA
sites.desc: ADHS monitoring one returning passenger under 42-day observation. Asymptomatic as of 08 May. Part of 9-person domestic US monitoring cohort across 6 states. CDC notified ADHS 05 May; public risk assessed as very low.

sites.name: CALIFORNIA
sites.desc: CDPH coordinating with local health officials to monitor one returned Hondius traveler via daily temperature checks and symptom assessment. A second California resident remains aboard the ship and will transit Tenerife to Nebraska quarantine via CDC-escorted State Dept charter. No California residents reported ill or infected as of 09 May.

sites.name: GEORGIA
sites.desc: Georgia DPH monitoring two residents who returned from Hondius. Both in good health with no signs of infection as of 08 May. Following CDC recommendations.

sites.name: TEXAS
sites.desc: Texas DSHS monitoring two returning Hondius passengers. Both asymptomatic. Part of 9-person US domestic monitoring cohort across 6 states.

sites.name: VIRGINIA
sites.desc: VDH monitoring one returning Hondius passenger. Asymptomatic. President Trump stated 08 May the US situation is 'very much, we hope, under control.' CDC classified response as Level-3 (lowest emergency activation tier).

sites.name: NEW JERSEY
sites.desc: NJ health authorities monitoring two individuals with potential post-disembarkation exposure to a Hondius passenger. Neither symptomatic as of 09 May. Part of the 6-state US monitoring cohort per ABC News reporting of at least 9 US residents under monitoring.

sites.name: NEBRASKA
sites.desc: Nebraska Medicine / UNMC National Quarantine Unit and Biocontainment Unit fully staffed and activated at Offutt AFB, Bellevue. CDC team pre-deployed. 17 American Hondius passengers to arrive via CDC-escorted State Dept biocontainment charter from Tenerife following Sunday docking. NQU medical director Dr. Wadman confirmed all 17 are asymptomatic; anyone developing symptoms to be moved to Biocontainment Unit.

sites.name: MANILA
sites.desc: 38 Filipino crew members aboard Hondius; Philippines DOH confirmed none are currently ill as of 08 May. In close coordination with vessel operator and international authorities. Monitoring continues pending Tenerife disembarkation.

sites.name: DUBLIN
sites.desc: Two Irish nationals confirmed aboard Hondius per RTE. Ireland is among nine EU/EEA nationalities on board per ECDC briefing. Irish Dept of Health coordinating with ECDC and WHO; returning Irish nationals to quarantine per national protocol.

sites.name: PRAIA
sites.desc: Hondius anchored off Praia 03–06 May; departed 19:15 local 06 May for Tenerife. Three medevac patients evacuated here 06 May by air ambulance before transfer to Netherlands. Cape Verde assessed unable to handle full passenger evacuation — basis for WHO requesting Tenerife docking. Argentine biological material and 2,500 diagnostic kits dispatched among five recipient countries.
